Analyzing the database, extract the following information:
List of all RDIs (Diagnostic Trouble Codes)List of all DTCs with their associated DTC tablesList of all I/O (Input/Output) componentsList of all routinesWhat are the main diagnostic services associated with point 1?
Referring to the list of RDIs from point 1:
Request an RDI and interpret its hexadecimal responsePlace yourself in driving conditions that would modify the content of the chosen RDISimulate a speed of 60 km/h, request the associated RDI, interpret the response, and repeatthis step simulating 150 km/h, 250 km/h, and 600 km/h speeds.Write the content of 3 RDIs using the specific diagnostic service and verify their correctwriting by querying the control unit.
Consulting the list of DTCs:
Create a fault conditionQuery the control unit to assess its status bytePerform and describe the maneuvers required to set bits 0, 1, and 2 to 0Clear the error memory
